messages:
Elena Torres: Opening a lightweight thread to get alignment on the 'Region availability & residency' doc edits. I want to add: 1) explicit SDK behavior for the 'region' param, 2) alias hostname guidance (regional vs global), and 3) a small availability row for sa-east-1 (Brazil) marked 'coming soon'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478
Mark Patel: Sounds good. One ask: include one-liner examples for Node, Java, and Ruby so we cover more SDK users. Also clarify what happens to KV/prefix caches when migrating regions.
Jinsoo Park: For caching: add note "Caches (prefix/KV) are region-local; expect initial cold misses after switching regions until caches warm." Avoid hard guarantees on timing.
Elena Torres: Drafted short snippets in the PR. Node sample:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Translate: Good morning' });
```
Java sample:
```java
RedwoodClient client = new RedwoodClient.Builder()
  .apiKey(System.getenv("RW_KEY"))
  .region("ap-southeast-1")
  .build();
client.generate(new GenerateRequest("redwood-7b", "Summarize: notes"));
```
Ruby sample:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['RW_KEY'], region: 'sa-east-1')
resp = client.generate(model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Hello')
```
Mark Patel: Good variety. For alias hosts: recommend a short table in prose: regional alias examples like eu.api.redwood.ai, ap-southeast-1.api.redwood.ai, and note that api.redwood.ai will route to the global/default endpoint. Mention that private deployments may use customer-managed hostnames.
Riley (docs-ci): Ran link-check and image checks. Internal region matrix asset exists at /assets/region-matrix-v2.png. Flagged one external map link — suggest replacing with internal asset. Also CI will validate that code fences are correctly language-tagged.
Elena Torres: Replaced external map with /assets/region-matrix-v2.png and added an availability row: eu-west-1 (GA), ap-southeast-1 (GA), ap-northeast-2 (preview), sa-east-1 (coming soon). Added a migration checklist: update SDK region param, switch base URL if you use direct hostnames, verify quotas per region, expect cache warm-up.
legal-bot: Please include link to the DPA/compliance page: https://redwood.ai/compliance/dpa and avoid absolute claims like "data never leaves". Suggested phrasing: "Hosted regional endpoints process and store data within the selected region for standard accounts. Custom residency commitments require contractual agreement; contact legal@redwood.ai"
Jinsoo Park: Minor tweak: add a short note about fallback behavior: "If a regional endpoint is unavailable, requests may fallback to a compatible model on the global endpoint per routing policy; this may cause cross-region processing."
Elena Torres: Added the fallback note and the legal wording. Also added a tiny curl migration example using a regional hostname:
```bash
curl -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
Mark Patel: One last suggestion: call out rate-limits/quota are applied per-region and link to the quota docs section. Otherwise LGTM.
Riley (docs-ci): Link-check passed (all internal links). PR ready once legal confirms final wording.
Elena Torres: Thanks all — will merge after legal sign-off and CI green.
